title: An elephant's bath-time routine

scenes.headline: Step 1: walk into the river
scenes.body: Asian elephants at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, Sri Lanka.

scenes.headline: Step 2: soak to cool down
scenes.body: Asian elephants bathe often and submerge to cool off.

scenes.headline: Step 3: sit, spray, repeat
scenes.body: The trunk doubles as a shower hose.

scenes.headline: Step 4: back to snacking
scenes.body: Elephants spend 12–18 hours a day finding and eating food.

scenes.label: of its body mass eaten every day

caption:
Get ready with me: elephant edition.

After the bath, Asian elephants often coat themselves in mud or soil to keep their skin cool.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Elephas maximus). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: GRWM/routine told as numbered steps with real footage. Pinnawala is a captive orphanage and is named on screen — not presented as wild behaviour.
